changes.title: White House says Saudi Arabia nuclear deal contingent on joining Abraham Accords
changes.summary: During a press briefing, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt echoed a social media post from President Trump that said any nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia would be contingent on them joining the Abraham Accords. NBC News' Monica Alba reports from the White House on the potential deal and the White House's appro.
